machine.name: Release readiness
machine.purpose: Check a release candidate, wait for its existing CI job, and request approval for that exact candidate. Finish with a release-ready record; publishing remains a separate user action.

states.name: Check the release candidate
states.description: Read sample/release.json. Check the four items in order and write artifacts/checklist.md for this candidate.

items.text: Test result belongs to this candidate

list.passCondition: This item has an explicit passing result and evidence for the current candidate.

qualityConditions.text: The evidence identifies the candidate and the checked item.

strategies.during: Use the host agent and record concise evidence in the task workspace.
strategies.onFailure: Record the concrete gap; do not mark it as passed.
strategies.onUncertain: Keep this state and ask for the missing information.

states.name: Wait for the existing CI job
states.description: Use jobId and candidateId from sample/release.json. Wait for an actual completion event for that same job and candidate.

qualityConditions.text: CI succeeded for the saved jobId and candidateId.

states.toolGuidance: Query the original job or receive its callback. The demo uses sample/ci-result.json; a real project must use its actual CI result.
states.configuration: Do not submit another build on resume. Pending or timeout without a result means hold.

strategies.during: Use the host agent and record concise evidence in the task workspace.
strategies.onFailure: Record the concrete gap; do not mark it as passed.
strategies.onUncertain: Keep this state and ask for the missing information.

states.name: Wait for explicit approval
states.description: Ask the reviewer to approve the exact candidate. Silence, old approvals, and the agent's own opinion are not approval.

qualityConditions.text: A reviewer explicitly approved this candidate after CI succeeded.

states.toolGuidance: Use a human reply or approved host event. The offline demo reads the clearly labeled fixture sample/approval.json.

strategies.during: Use the host agent and record concise evidence in the task workspace.
strategies.onFailure: Record the concrete gap; do not mark it as passed.
strategies.onUncertain: Keep this state and ask for the missing information.

states.name: Revise the candidate
states.description: Address the failed checks or review comments. A changed candidate needs a new ID, new CI evidence, and fresh approval; repeat the checklist.

strategies.during: Use the host agent and record concise evidence in the task workspace.
strategies.onFailure: Record the concrete gap; do not mark it as passed.
strategies.onUncertain: Keep this state and ask for the missing information.

states.name: Ready to release
states.description: Write artifacts/release-ready.md with checklist evidence, CI job, candidate, and reviewer approval. Do not publish, push tags, or deploy.

strategies.during: Use the host agent and record concise evidence in the task workspace.
strategies.onFailure: Record the concrete gap; do not mark it as passed.
strategies.onUncertain: Keep this state and ask for the missing information.
